zh: 当局感到被逼上了只能选择激进方案的境地：警察局长获得紧急权力，中止法治，下令向示威者开枪。警察在市中心用步枪射杀示威者，随后开赴郊区的工人住宅区，又杀死更多人。三天过后，89人毙命，逾千人受伤。
工人运动从此一蹶不振。社会民主党再也无法有效地动用大规模动员的威胁；而或许对工人运动打击最沉重的是，这几天表明，连警察队伍里那些名义上的社会主义者，向工人同胞开枪时也不会犹豫。
en: The authorities felt pushed to opt for a radical solution, and the police chief received emergency powers, suspended the rule of law, and gave the order to fire on the demonstrators. Police killed protesters with rifles in the center of the city, and then drove out to workers’ housing complexes in the suburbs and killed more. After three days, eighty-nine people were dead and over a thousand injured.

The workers’ movement was permanently crippled. The Social Democratic Party was unable to use the threat of mass mobilization effectively again, and, perhaps most damagingly, the days had shown that even the putatively socialist members of the police would not hesitate to fire on fellow workers.

zh: 1927年7月15日起义是1934年内战之前维也纳遭遇的最深重危机。司法宫起火的景象深深震撼了作家、文化批评家埃利亚斯·卡内蒂（Elias Canetti），促使他毕生的写作致力于理解群众与权力的关系。
对米塞斯来说，这一事件不是创伤，而是莫大的宽慰。他当时就在维也纳，写信给朋友说：“星期五的暴动像一场雷雨，涤清了空气。社会民主党用尽了一切权力手段，却输了这场博弈。街头较量以警察的彻底胜利告终。……所有军队都效忠政府。”
米塞斯接着写道：“社会民主党迄今为止一直用来恐吓政府和公众的那些威胁，证明远没有人们所相信的那么危险。”
正如他的传记作者所述，总罢工的失败令米塞斯“既惊讶又欣喜”。
对于镇压所使用的手段——它曾深深刺痛当时的许多人——他似乎泰然受之。紧急权力下杀人而不受追究，得到了米塞斯的认可。
en: The July 15, 1927, uprising was the deepest crisis in Vienna before the civil war of 1934. The sight of the Palace of Justice in flames shook the author and cultural critic Elias Canetti deeply, leading him to devote his life’s work to understanding the relationship between crowds and power.

For Mises, the event was not a trauma but a great relief. He was in Vienna at the time and wrote to a friend: “Friday’s putsch has cleansed the atmosphere like a thunderstorm. The social-democratic party has used all means of power and yet lost the game. The street fight ended in complete victory of the police. … All troops are loyal to the government.”

“The threats by which the social-democratic party has up to now permanently tried to bully the government and the public,” Mises continued, “have proved to be far less dangerous than one had believed.”
As his biographer describes, Mises was “surprised and delighted by the failure of the general strike.”
It appeared that he accepted lightly the means used in the suppression, which delivered a deep blow to many at the time. The right to kill with impunity under emergency powers met Mises’s approval.

zh: 与本书后面还会遇到的其他新自由主义者一样，民主对米塞斯而言并非绝对价值。他推崇民主，是因为民主最有可能产出有利于稳定的结果、营造自由经济交换的氛围。他确实表示过怀疑：民主产生的领袖是否比专制或贵族统治产生的更好；但他说这样想并未抓住要害：“民主宪政形态的意义与这一切全然不同。它的功能在于缔造和平、避免暴力革命。”
如果民众感到自己的声音和意见能够影响政府的构成，他们就会更少诉诸暴力手段。不过，平等的定义必须保持最低限度，止于法律面前人人平等。在这一限度之外强求平等，就是否认“人的天资禀赋各不相同”这一基本事实。
因此，作为投票者民主的一个关键补充，是他后来所称的“消费者民主”，它在市场上以购买和投资来表达。“诚然，这种民主中投票并不平等；有人拥有复数选票。但支配更多收入所带来的更大投票权，只能通过选举的考验来获取和保持。”他写道，财富“永远是消费者公投的结果”。
米塞斯对民主的功能性定义包含一个明确的推论：倘若民主不再起作用——即不再能确保稳定——那就没有任何理由继续维持它。
en: As with the other neoliberals we will encounter in these pages, democracy was not an absolute value for Mises. He admired it as the system most likely to produce an outcome amenable to stability and an atmosphere for free economic exchange. He did express doubts that democracy produced leaders better than those produced by autocracy or aristocracy, but he said that this was missing the point: “The significance of the democratic form of constitution is something quite different from all this. Its function is to make peace, to avoid violent revolutions.”

If populations felt that their voice and opinion had effects on the composition of the government, then they would less frequently reach for violent means. The definition of equality must remain minimalist though, ex-hausting itself with equality before the law. Attempting to enforce equality beyond this would be to deny the basic fact “that men are endowed differently by nature.”

Thus, a crucial complement to voters’ democracy was what he would later call “a consumer’s democracy,” expressed by purchases and investments in the marketplace. “True there is no equality of vote in this democracy; some have plural votes. But the greater voting power which the disposal of a greater income implies can only be acquired and maintained by the test of election.” Wealth, he wrote, was “always the result of a consumers’ plebiscite.”
Mises’s functional definition of democracy had a clear implication: should democracy cease to be functional—that is, cease to secure stability—there would be no reason to maintain it.

zh: 在1927年，民主已不再履行其首要功能，它没能阻止革命。米塞斯认为，在这种情况下，中止民主、以其他手段强制恢复秩序，完全正当。这场起义还昭示了新生福利国家与紧急状态法之间的结构性关联。谈判之中，社会民主党人在罢工期间争得的唯一让步，是政府不会动用紧急权力取消失业救济和社会住宅项目。
然而，在米塞斯看来，为了让奥地利工业重新具备竞争力，恰恰必须动用紧急权力取消这些项目。1930年2月，工商会以米塞斯为首席顾问，建议削减失业津贴以及疾病和意外伤害保险。如果工人想要遣散费，就应由工会会费支付，而不应由雇主或国家出资。
作为1930年三人经济委员会中最有影响力的一员，他论证说，贸易条件、利率和许多商品的价格都由世界经济形势决定，本非奥地利当局所能控制。当局唯一能改变的是工资和税收。两者都必须下调，以降低生产成本。
工商会的策略是把有组织的劳工重塑为非法力量，从而使其无从要求法律保护，并易于铲除。工商会推动通过一部“反恐怖法”，用于对付罢工工人。
1934年内战中，一部类似的法律被再度使用：当年警察开枪射杀示威者的工人住宅区再次遭到攻击并被制服。
en: In 1927, democracy had ceased to fulfill its primary function. It did not prevent revolution. In that case, Mises believed, it was perfectly legitimate to suspend it and enforce order by other means. The structural link between the nascent welfare state and emergency law was also clear in the uprising. In the course of negotiations, the only concession that Social Democrats were able to secure during the strike was that the government would not use its emergency powers to abolish unemployment benefits and social housing programs.

Yet this was precisely what Mises felt was necessary in order to make Austrian industry competitive again. In February 1930 the Chamber of Commerce, with Mises as its primary adviser, recommended cuts to unemployment benefits and to health and accident insurance. If workers wanted severance pay, it should come out of union dues rather than from the employer or state.

As the most influential member of a three-person Economic Commission in 1930, he argued that the terms of trade, the interest rate, and the prices of many commodities were determined by world economic conditions, and were thus out of the control of the Austrian authorities. The only thing they could change were wages and taxes. Both had to be lowered to bring down production costs.

The tactic of the Chamber of Commerce was to recast organized labor as illegal, and thus unable to demand protection under the law and prone to extirpation. The Chamber promoted the passage of an “anti-terror law” to be used against striking workers.
A similar version would be used in the civil war of 1934 when the housing estates where police had shot demonstrators were attacked again and subdued.

zh: 批评者称工商会的这套政策是“自上而下的阶级战争”，说这部反恐怖法表明“一如既往，当权者们的脑力所能想出的对付工人和职员的手段，唯有暴力”。
米塞斯所在工商会的政策建议，展示了他的模型付诸运行的样子。一旦把民主作功能性理解，那么当市场稳定有此需要时，民主便可以被搁置。米塞斯曾为之撰稿的《新自由报》（Neue Freie Presse）呼吁对经济“真正去政治化”（wirkli
Ökonomischen）。
毋庸讳言，这种“去政治化”本身极为政治，且意味着行政权力的剧烈行使。外国竞争——引申而言，搬出世界经济这一修辞武器——成了一根大棒，用来砸回工人在保险、遣散费和失业救济上赢得的社会政策成果。
en: Critics called the Chamber of Commerce policies “class war from above” and said that the anti-terror law showed that “as always, the only means that the brains of those in power can think of to use against workers and employees is violence.”
The recommendation of Mises’s Chamber of Commerce showed his model in action. Understood functionally, democracy could be suspended when this is required for the stability of the market. The
for which Mises wrote articles, called for the “actual depoliticization of the economic” (wirkli

Needless to say, this form of “depoliticization” was very political, and entailed a dramatic application of executive power. Foreign competition, and by extension the rhetorical weapon of invoking the world economy, was a bludgeon to beat back social policy gains in worker insurance, severance pay, and unemployment benefits.

zh: 米塞斯和哈耶克都相信，1929年的衰退起因于货币政策松弛与过度投资，而衰退之所以沦为萧条，责任在工会。失业是自愿失业。“失业是工资问题，不是工作问题……对失业者的救济，才是首先把失业造成一种持久现象的东西。”
1931年，米塞斯向德国实业家发表题为《世界经济危机的成因》的演讲，谴责那些“向工会投降”的政府——而工会“使用暴力”来追求其目标。“倘若政府照其常规行事，出面制止那些欺凌求职者、毁坏机器及企业家其他财产的犯罪分子，局面就会不同。”
恰在此时，他以国际商会官方身份身处英国，为奥地利寻求外国投资。有组织的劳工为阻止削减工资而进行的斗争，使此事困难重重。世界经济的需求，与有组织工人的需求，摆到了对立面。
en: Mises and Hayek both believed that the 1929 slump was caused by loose monetary policy and overinvestment, and that unions were the reason that the slump turned into a depression. Unemployment was voluntary. “Unemployment is a problem of wages, not of work … the assistance of the unemployed is what first creates unemployment as a permanent phenomenon.”

In a lecture to German industrialists in 1931 titled “The Causes of the World Economic Crisis,” Mises condemned governments that had “capitulated to the unions,” which pursue their goals “by the use of violence.” “Were it to proceed in its usual way and interfere with the criminals who abuse jobseekers and vandalize the machines and other of the entrepreneurs, then circumstances would be different.”

At this exact time, he was in England in his official capacity for the ICC, seeking foreign investment in Austria. The struggle of organized labor against the reduction of their wages made this difficult. The needs of the world economy were arrayed against those of the organized workers.

zh: 在第二帝国时期的巴黎，奥斯曼为商业和消费开辟通道的宏大工程，把城市塞满了建筑与服务业劳工。这些被边缘化、被贫困化的人群在巴黎公社中夺占了城市空间；公社延续了数月，最终在所谓“流血周”中被终结，两万名公社社员殒命。可以说，米塞斯这样的自由主义国际主义者，在1920年代想象的是对世界来一轮奥斯曼化：拆倒阻碍商业的砖墙，让地球资源得到更具生产性的利用。他们的愿景要求商品与资本始终保持流动，追逐利润、奔赴新的生产场所。
en: In Second Empire Paris, Haussmann’s mammoth project to open up pathways for trade and consumption filled the city with construction and service laborers. Marginalized and impoverished, they seized urban space for themselves in the Paris Commune, which lasted for several months, until it was ended in the so-called Bloody Week and the deaths of 20,000 communards. One could argue that liberal internationalists like Mises in the 1920s imagined the Haussmanization of the world, demolishing the brick walls that impeded commerce to permit a more productive use of the earth’s resources. Their vision required that goods and capital remain in movement, pursuing profit and new sites of productivity.

zh: 红色维也纳塑造了那些将组建新自由主义运动的奥地利人的世界观，根深蒂固地确立了一个观念：劳动与资本之间是一场武装对峙。米塞斯在回忆录中指出局势之严峻：社民党随时可以用罢工“使全部经济生活瘫痪”。最要紧的是，社会民主党人掌控着军队，这支部队“装备步枪和机枪、轻型火炮，弹药充足，兵力至少是政府可支配力量的三倍”。
米塞斯后来把集体谈判称为“桌子底下的枪”。他或许是想打个比方，但在维也纳，这并不是比方。
en: Red Vienna shaped the worldview of the Austrians who would form the neoliberal movement, entrenching the idea of an armed standoff between labor and capital. In his memoirs Mises pointed out the drastic nature of the situation. The party “could paralyze all economic life at any time” with a strike. Most importantly, the Social Democrats had control of the army, which was “equipped with rifles and machine guns, light artillery, ample munitions, and manpower at least three times greater than that available to the government.”
Mises later described collective bargaining as the “gun under the table.” He might have meant it as a metaphor, but it was not a metaphor in Vienna.

zh: 到1927年，已经存在一个界定明确、在国际上组织起来的亲商力量网络，为着共同目标搜集经济信息。这个目标就是消极的全球整合——重建开放的世界经济。这是一种工商会的愿景：让实业界人士自主治理其事务，外力干预越少越好。然而，在这场动员的背后，还隐藏着插在商界与国家之间的第三方：经济知识的生产者。即便目标是让世界经济自行支配资源配置，实业界人士也无法亲自做到。他们需要统计学家和经济学家。莫里森-贝尔制作地图时，起点正是国联的统计数据。与十九世纪末那种典型关切政策的经济学家——他们本是社会改良者，旨在抵消和缓和资本主义的效应——不同，战间期涌现出一代经济学家，力图把自己的知识用于为资本服务。
en: By 1927 there was a well-defined and internationally organized network of pro-business forces engaged in the collection of economic information in pursuit of a common goal of negative global integration—the reestablishment of an open world economy. It was a Chamber of Commerce vision: give the businesspeople the power to govern their own affairs, and interfere as little as possible. Hidden in the mobilization, however, was a third party intervening between business and state: the economic knowledge producer. Even if the goal was to let the world economy rule, the businesspeople could not do it for themselves. They required statisticians and economists. When Morrison-Bell needed to construct his map, he started with statistics from the League of Nations. In contrast to the typical policy-minded economist in the late nineteenth century, who would have been a social reformer seeking to counteract and mollify the effects of capitalism, there emerged in the interwar period a generation of economists who sought to apply their knowledge in service of capital.

zh: 像商品那样看世界
哈伯勒、哈耶克和马赫卢普的社会化，是在米塞斯的私人研讨班上完成的。这个班在 Stubenring 工商会米塞斯的办公室里聚会。每两周聚会一次。晚上7点，一群二十来岁、三十来岁的年轻知识分子鱼贯穿过门厅的铅条镶嵌玻璃，登上饰有新艺术风格女像柱的楼梯，来到米塞斯的办公室；他坐在办公桌后，周围多至二十五人。
讨论持续到夜里10点左右，随后移师附近的意大利餐馆继续进行，甚至再到艺术家咖啡馆（Café Künstler）接着聊。据哈伯勒回忆，论持久，米塞斯是铁杆中的铁杆，凌晨1点以前从不离场。
en: The socialization of Haberler, Hayek, and Machlup came at Mises’s private seminar, which met in his office at the Chamber of Commerce on the Stubenring. Every two weeks at 7:00 p.m., a flock of young intellectuals in their twenties and thirties would pass under the leaded glass of the entrance and up the stairs past the art nouveau caryatids to Mises’s office, where he would sit behind his desk with as many as twenty-five people gathered around him.

Discussion would last until around 10:00 p.m. and continue in the Italian restaurant nearby, and continue even further at Café Künstler. Haberler recalls that Mises was in the hard core for endurance, never leaving before 1:00 a.m.

zh: 工商会俨然一所另类大学。多位享有国际声誉的经济学家在此进出，包括莱昂内尔·罗宾斯、拉格纳·努克塞（Ragnar Nurkse）和霍华德·S. 埃利斯（Howard S. Ellis）。
米塞斯夸口说，商会的图书馆藏有连维也纳大学都没有的资料。
政府部门有时也会查用商会的统计材料——其质量胜过政府各部门自己搜集的资料。私人研讨班的讨论涉猎极广，在参与者中间传为传奇。有位参加者写过一首煽情的打油诗，后来刊印在朝圣山学社的出版物上，可见这个圈子对许多会员的情感分量。其中一节写道：“今晚我要去米塞斯那里，因为那是我最爱待的地方，维也纳没有哪里比那儿更好，可以谈论经济、真理与社会。”
en: The Chamber acted as a kind of alternative university. Economists of international reputation passed through it, including Lionel Robbins, Ragnar Nurkse, and Howard S. Ellis.
Mises boasted that its library contained material that even the University of Vienna did not have.

Government offices occasionally consulted the Chamber’s statistical material, which was superior to their own collection. The discussions at the private seminar were wide-ranging and became legendary for the participants. One of the participants wrote kitschy verse, later reproduced in the publication of the Mont Pèlerin Society, suggesting its sentimental power for many of the members. A sample stanza read: “I’m going tonight to Mises, because that’s where I love to be, there’s nowhere so nice in Vienna, to talk about economy, truth and society.”

zh: 对米塞斯圈子来说，紧要的是一位成员1928年提出的那个问题：能否“在经济理论与经济政策之间架起一座桥梁”？
1920年代末，奥地利自由主义者面对的问题是：什么样的经济信息是可靠的？什么样的信息在政治上是有用的？司法宫大火后的次月，戈特弗里德·哈伯勒就在 Stubenring 处理这一问题——他正在收尾那本关于“指数的意义”的著作。

哈伯勒1900年出生于一个殷实的公务员家庭，老家是林木葱茏的维也纳近郊普克斯多夫（Purkersdorf）。此地最出名的，是分离派建筑师约瑟夫·霍夫曼（Josef Hoffmann）设计的那座疗养院。哈伯勒还在蹒跚学步时疗养院落成，古斯塔夫·马勒、阿诺尔德·勋伯格（Arnold Schönberg）、阿图尔·施尼茨勒（Arthur Schnitzler）等名家曾在此云集。这座建筑线条洁净、几何分明，体现了分离派的艺术理念；同一理念还更集中地体现在维也纳市中心那座顶着金色叶冠圆顶的分离派会馆建筑上。他们的目标是 Gesamtkunstwerk，即总体艺术品。艺术应为尘世带来和谐与完美。
en: At stake for the Mises Circle was the question one member asked in 1928: Is it possible “to build a bridge between economic theory and economic policy?”

The question of the late 1920s for the Austrian liberals was: What kind of economic information was reliable and what kind of information was politically useful? The month after the Palace of Justice burned, Gottfried Haberler was addressing this question in the Stubenring, finishing his book on “the meaning of index numbers.”

Haberler was born in 1900 to a family of well-off civil servants, in the sylvan Viennese suburb of Purkersdorf, best known for its sanatorium designed by the Secession architect Josef Hoffmann. Built when Haberler was a toddler, the sanatorium was a gathering place for luminaries like Gustav Mahler, Arnold Schönberg, and Arthur Schnitzler. The clean white lines and geometry of the building reflected the artistic vision of the Secession, further embodied in the building in downtown Vienna with its golden leafy globe. Their goal was the
the total work of art. Art should bring harmony and perfection to earth.

zh: 尽管克里姆特（Klimt）和席勒（Schiele）蜿蜒流线的形体，与经济学家干巴巴的文本之间看似天差地别，哈伯勒及其奥地利自由主义同道所做的却是相类的事情。他们的问题很根本，在某些层面上也同样是美学问题：我们应当如何测量“个人经济行为的复杂网格”，又该如何将它视觉地呈现出来？
我们应当向公众展示经济行为的哪一副面孔？哈伯勒1927年写道，经济学关心的不仅是外在行动，还有内在动机——“心理”与“精神”（Geist）的问题。正因如此，他说，经济学属于人文科学之列，即 Geisteswissenschaften，一门“精神科学”。
en: Though the distance between the sinuous forms of Klimt and Schiele and the dry texts of economists might seem vast, Haberler and his fellow Austrian liberals were engaged with something similar. Their questions were basic, and at some level also aesthetic: How should we measure the “complicated latticework of individual economic acts,” and how can we represent it visually?

What face of economic actions should we present to the public? Haberler wrote in 1927 that economics was concerned not only with outward actions but also with internal motivations, matters of the “psyche” and the “spirit,” or
For this reason, he said, economics was one of the humanities, or
a “science of the spirit.”

zh: 但一门趋向抽象的科学如何付诸操作？米塞斯、哈伯勒和其他经济学家与商界领袖并肩工作，提供数据和概念，支撑那个无墙商业世界之梦。哈伯勒最早的著名论文探讨比较成本理论，最初就是维也纳的一次发言。

他的目标是为自由贸易打造一种辩护，使其不仅在理论上成立，也在第一次世界大战后现实的政治处境中成立。他的关键问题关乎自由迁徙。自由贸易的主要论据是国际分工，但“迁徙自由并不存在，从来没有存在过，恐怕也永远不会存在”。即便可能，它也并不可取。鲁尔区会变得拥挤不堪，阿尔卑斯山区的人口会完全流失：“即使不是民族主义者，也会觉得这类事情不可欲。”哈伯勒提出，他要证明“即便没有迁徙自由、即便各族人民牢牢扎根于自己的国家，自由贸易对所有人仍然有利”。
en: But how to operationalize a science that tended to abstraction? Mises, Haberler, and other economists worked alongside business leaders to provide data and concepts that supported the dream of a world of commerce without walls. Haberler’s earliest notable article was on the theory of comparative costs, which began as a presentation in Vienna.

His goal was to create a defense of free trade that worked not only in theory but also in the real-life political circumstances of the post–First World War world. His main question concerned free migration. The main argument for free trade was the international division of labor, but “freedom of migration does not exist, has never existed and probably never will exist.” It would not be desirable even if it were possible. The Ruhr Valley would become unbelievably crowded, and the Alps would empty out entirely: “One need not be a nationalist for such things to be undesirable.” Haberler proposed that he could prove that “free trade is beneficial for all even when there is no freedom of migration and the peoples remain firmly rooted in their countries.”

zh: 他的办法是重访大卫·李嘉图的比较优势观念，同时把它从已经破产的劳动价值论的基底上重新铸造。在他的版本中，只要价格能够流动，工人就无须跨越国界流动。如果价格准确反映市场上相对的供给与需求，价格就会把企业家导向其资源的最有效用途。然而，价格要履行其职能，就必须不遭遇阻力。他举了劳动这个具体例子：“在这里，价格机制部分地被关闭，就可能出现真实的摩擦损失，表现为罢工和失业。”所幸，他指出，“劳动是一切生产要素中最具流动性、也最具多样性的”。
即便失业数字保持不变，实际的失业人群通常也在不断进出流转——人们从一个岗位流向另一个岗位。在要求“价格机制无误地运转”时，哈伯勒唤起的形象令人想到一座巨大的钟表机械或工厂装置，把零部件从这个工位送往另一个工位。他援引了巴斯夏（Bastiat）等先行者：自由贸易运作起来就像发明创造，不断重新布置生产版图——当一个工作场所已经过时或被海外竞争挤出时，就把工人送往新的工作场所。
en: He did so by revisiting David Ricardo’s idea of comparative advantage but recasting it without the discredited labor theory of value. In his version, workers did not need to be mobile over national borders as long as prices were. If prices accurately reflected the relative supply and demand on markets, then these would guide entrepreneurs to the most efficient use of their resources. For prices to serve their function, however, they must not encounter resistance. He gave the specific example of labor: “Here the price mechanism is partially switched off, and real frictional losses can occur in the form of strikes and unemployment.” Luckily, he pointed out, “labor was the most mobile and diverse of all the factors of production.”

Even if unemployment figures remained constant, the actual mass of unemployed usually rotated in and out as people moved from position to position. In the demand for the “faultless functioning of the price mechanism,” Haberler conjured an image reminiscent of an enormous clockwork or factory apparatus, shuttling components from one location to the other. He cited earlier thinkers like Bastiat, who argued that free trade worked like invention, con-stantly rearranging the landscape of production, sending workers to new places of work when one has been outmoded or squeezed out by overseas competition.

zh: 工人本身只是承载“劳动”这一属性的中性容器，可以像一笔投资资本或一车煤炭那样被挪移。哈伯勒用一种富于感染力的地理学表述了这一愿景：“闲置的生产设施实际上并非资本毁灭、亏损的见证——在核算分工的收益时必须扣除的那类损失——毋宁说，它们是国际分工所造就的经济进步的里程碑。”
无论人们对生计与故土怀有多少情感依恋，关闭的工厂都不是逝去生活方式的墓碑，而是市场前进征程的纪念碑。
en: The workers themselves were neutral containers of the attribute of labor, as capable of relocation as a chunk of investment capital or a carriage-load of coal. Haberler expressed the vision in an evocative geography: “Inactive production facilities are not actually witnesses to the destruction of capital, of losses that must be calculated against the advantages of the division of labor; rather, they are milestones of the economic progress produced by the international division of labor.”
Regardless of any emotional attachment felt by people to livelihood and place, the shuttered factory was not a tombstone to a lost way of life but a monument to the forward march of the market.

zh: 哈伯勒认为，战后奥地利的工资必须下降，以恢复竞争力。1933年，他在维也纳一家报纸的文章里说得直白：“拆除关税将给一系列经济部门带来痛苦……但转型之痛不会是长期的，而且绝不至于比多年关税瘾所把我们拖入的不幸更糟糕。”

他提出问题：“一个在几乎方方面面装备都更差的经济，如何在不靠超高关税自我保护的情况下，抵挡生产条件更好的工业和农业的竞争？”答案很简单：“当工资以及所有其他形式的收入相应地更微薄时，贫穷的经济就能与富裕的经济竞争。”他说得不留情面：“当我们彻底面对必要的后果，当生活水平降到足够低、收入跌到足够低，经济就能前进，一切照常。……当出口产业中的熟练工人转入矿井，也许转入农业和其他经济部门——这些部门的产品能够更合算地交换到合格的出口商品——而其余工人尽可能移居海外之后，也许人人都会重新就业，条件是生活水平显著降低。”
在哈伯勒看来，奥地利是全球化风暴中小国家的典型个案。正如他几年前所写，像美国和英国“世界帝国”（world empire）那样的巨国，或许还能实行稳定国内物价水平的政策，但小国必须保持对外国投资的吸引力，因此只能专注于稳定货币。
世界经济的纪律，无人能够逃脱。
en: Haberler thought wages in postwar Austria must fall to restore competitiveness. He put it plainly in a newspaper article in Vienna in 1933: “The dismantlement of tariffs will bring pain to a series of economic sectors … but the pains of transition will not be long term, they will also definitely not be worse than the unhappiness that we have been plunged into by years of tariff addiction.”

He asked the question: “How can an economy that is more poorly equipped in almost every respect withstand the competition of an industry and agriculture working with better production conditions without protecting itself with extra-high tariffs?” The answer was simple: “The poor economy can compete with the rich when the wages and all other forms of income are correspondingly smaller.” He put it bluntly: “When we have faced the necessary consequences completely, when the standard of living has sunk low enough, income has fallen far enough, then the economy can progress, business as usual. … When the skilled workers in export industry have moved into the coal mines, maybe into agriculture and other economic sectors too, whose products can be better exchanged for qualified export goods and the rest of the workers, insofar as possible, have emigrated, then maybe all will be employed again, granted at a pronouncedly lower standard of living.”

For Haberler, Austria was a prototypical case of small state in the storms of globalization. As he had written a few years earlier, huge countries like the United States and the British “world empire” might be able to follow policies of stabilizing the internal price level, but small countries needed to remain attractive to foreign investment and therefore had to concentrate on stabilizing their currency.
There was no escape from the discipline of the world economy.

zh: 至关重要的是，决策者不能向民众诉求让步。一个恰当的例子，是股市崩盘后稳定初级商品价格的要求。1931年，哈伯勒撰文反对为特定商品稳定价格水平的设想。他承认，在价格稳定的方案下，“社会摩擦会更小，因为届时可以向工人提供上涨的工资、在社会产品中更大的份额——以食利者为代价——”，但结果将是通货膨胀。他说，个人宁可冒“社会摩擦加剧”的风险，也不愿冒通胀的风险。
在此他追随其导师米塞斯。米塞斯抱怨说，各国政府已被“那种指望低利率和物价上涨来拯救自己的舆论”所俘获。因为商界渴求廉价信贷，政府便鼓励银行多印钞票，但短期利润“长期来看必然造成危机与萧条的局面”。
必须由各银行顶住公众压力——而银行则应由经济学家教导其行为后果。唯有如此，建立在可靠货币本位之上的国际贸易才能保全。
en: It was essential that policy makers not cave to popular demands. A case in point was the demand for stabilization of commodity prices in the wake of the stock market crash. In 1931 Haberler wrote against the idea of stabilizing the price level for certain commodities. He acknowledged that under a scheme of stabilized prices “social friction is less, since the worker can then be offered rising wages and a larger share—at the expense of rentiers—in the social product,” but the outcome would be inflation. He said that he would personally rather risk the “increase of social friction” than risk inflation.

Here he followed his mentor Mises, who complained that governments had been captive to “public opinion, which looks for salvation in low rates of interest and rising prices.” Because the business world desired cheap credit, governments encouraged banks to print money, but short-term profits “in the long run must inevitably create a situation of crisis and depression.”
Public pressure must be resisted by the banks, schooled by economists on the consequences of their actions. Only then could international trade based on a reliable currency standard be preserved.

zh: 面对罢工、关税以及民主压力迫使银行放松信贷的这个不完美世界，哈伯勒诉诸一个理想类型，为他的自由贸易处方辩护。在1930年代的著述中，他从“一个无空间的、囊括整个世界的封闭经济”模型出发，然后“一个一个地引入那些把该经济分割、瓦解的条件”。
他解释说，自己给“国家”这个范畴加上引号，是因为在世界经济一体化模型所涉的资源分布中，资源与“政治边界”并不必然重合。

这种视角暂时搁置政治因素，创造出一幅要么先于民族国家、要么超越民族国家的世界图景——取决于你怎么看。整个地球是一个自然禀赋的容器，政治共同体在其上主张权利。哈伯勒的理想政策，要让现实更接近那个“无空间”的世界经济模型——在那里，无论人造障碍还是地理障碍，都不阻碍通过自由市场机制对地球资源作最有效的配置。想象一个无空间的世界，在1930年代并非纯粹的幻想。某些情况下，它已近乎现实。哈伯勒指出，电话与电报的连接使货币、股票和商品市场几乎同步联动。
本地价格与世界价格同涨同落。
许多商品已经是“国际性”的——从海外进口比在国内生产更有利可图。运输在追赶通信。两者都趋向于距离的消失。
en: Faced with the imperfect world of strikes, tariffs, and democratic pressure on banks for loose credit, Haberler turned to an ideal type to defend his prescription of free trade. In his 1930s writings, he began with a model of what he called a “spaceless closed economy embracing the whole world” and introduced “one by one the circumstances which divide and disintegrate that economy.”

He explained that he used the category of “countries” in quotation marks because the distribution of resources relevant to a model of world economic integration did not necessarily align with “political borders.”

This optic bracketed the political, creating a vision of the world that was either pre- or postnational, depending on how one looked at it. The whole earth was a container of natural endowments over which political communities made claims. Haberler’s ideal policy would make reality more closely resemble the model of a “spaceless” world economy where neither man-made nor geographical obstacles hindered the most efficient allocation of the earth’s resources through the mechanisms of the free market. Imagining a spaceless world was not pure fantasy in the 1930s. In some cases it had come close to reality. Haberler pointed out that telephone and telegraph links meant that markets for currency, stocks, and commodities reacted nearly in tandem.
Local and world prices moved together.

Many goods were “international” insofar as it was more profitable to import them from overseas than produce them at home. Transportation chased communication. Both tended toward the disappearance of distance.

zh: 哈伯勒把世界看成一个假想统一体，继而着手编目那些破坏统一的障碍。距离正逐步被克服。海关税费与关税这类人造的法律障碍却顽固存在。他写道，“筑起关税高墙”具有“与运输成本变化完全相同的后果”，也就是说，它们为商品的运输增添了一段垂直距离，而非水平距离。
他重复的已是国联内部的老生常谈。1932年，萨尔泰写道：“保护关税在世界经济中所占的位置，若将其作为一个整体及其不可避免的效应来看，再清楚不过。它们就像山脉一类的天然屏障、或其他交通障碍，提高了人们为相距遥远地区之间产品交换的好处与节约所支付的价格。”
国联经济学家们的自由主义地理学，把关税铸成有高度可攀的隐喻屏障。
en: Haberler saw the world as a hypothetical unity and proceeded to catalog the obstacles that disrupted that unity. Distance was gradually being overcome. Man-made legal obstacles of customs duties and tariffs persisted. He wrote that the “raising of tariff walls” had “exactly the same consequences as changes in transportation cost,” meaning that they created a vertical, rather than horizontal, distance for goods to travel.

He was repeating what had become common wisdom at the League of Nations. In 1932 Salter wrote that “the place which protective tariffs occupy in the world’s economy and, regarded, as a whole and inevitable effect, are perfectly clear. They are like the natural impediments of mountain range or other obstacles to transport which increase the price paid for the benefits and economies resulting from the inter-change of products of widely sundered regions.”
The liberal geography of the League economists cast tariffs as metaphorical barriers with height to be climbed over.

zh: 然而，最需费力拆除的，是阻碍那最关键商品——人类劳动——自由流动的障碍。在哈伯勒眼中，劳动是粘滞的，但一旦不得不流动，就表现出很强的适应能力。他赞扬工人的适应能力，却谴责他们想要固守原地。危险在于劳动获得了充当锚的盟友。他把有组织的劳工，连同“国家在失业保险与失业救济方面对劳动问题的干预”，一并归咎为降低了劳动力的“流动性和适应性”。
工会不只是锚。与米塞斯一样，他把工会看作墙。他称工会为“进入某些行业的人为壁垒”——凭借对人的劳动力这一商品的“垄断权力”维持的障碍。

要让自由贸易运作，工会的壁垒必须倒下。只有让劳动力承受民族国家容器内部供求的推拉，这个容纳劳动的民族国家容器才能完好如初。第一次世界大战之后，米塞斯和哈伯勒这样的奥地利自由主义者认为，破碎的世界必须经由一场隐喻意义上和字面意义上的拆迁来重建。罢工的工人和庇护国内产业的关税，都被定义为必须摧毁的墙。吊诡的是，奥地利自由主义者把这场拆迁看作纯粹的消极过程，仿佛那只是腾出空间的问题。然而，把商业空间重新缝合起来，实在是一个积极的进程。这支在维也纳凝聚成型的新自由主义思想运动核心群体，在国际商会这个“商人国际”以及国联那里找到了最亲密的伙伴。这两个机构都像是重建资本主义两大世界边界的搭档。资本、商品须能自由流动，工资须能自由调整，国界不应妨碍这些变动。哈伯勒理论中的新意，在于把民族国家作为劳动容器加以挽救。他的比较成本理论暗示：只要工会设立的内部壁垒被摧毁，自由贸易就能弥补国际劳动力流动的缺失。哈伯勒的愿景揭示出，“要塞欧洲”其实是一种像商品那样观看世界的方式。国与国之间的墙，应为商品而倒，不为人民而倒。
en: Yet most mettlesome of all were the obstacles that impeded the free movement of that most essential commodity: human labor. Haberler saw labor as sticky but highly versatile when forced to move. He praised workers for their ability to adapt but condemned them for wanting to stay in place. The danger lay where labor gained allies that acted as anchors. He blamed organized labor and “state intervention in labor questions in connection with unemployment insurance and unemployment relief” for decreasing labor’s “mobility and adaptability.”

Trade unions were not only anchors. Like Mises, he saw them as walls. He described unions as “artificial obstacles to entry into certain occupations”—barriers upheld through “monopoly power” over the commodity of human expenditure of effort.

For free trade to work, the barriers of the trade union needed to fall. Only by being subject to the push and pull of demand within the nation-state could the nation-state container for labor remain intact. After the First World War, Austrian liberals like Mises and Haberler felt that the shattered world must be rebuilt by a process of metaphorical and literal demolition. Striking workers and tariffs to shelter domestic industries were both defined as walls to be destroyed. Paradoxically, Austrian liberals saw this demolition as a purely negative process, as if it were only a question of clearing space. But knitting commercial space back together was very much an active process. The core cohort of the neoliberal intellectual movement that had coalesced in Vienna had found their closest partners in the Businessman’s International of the ICC and the League of Nations. Both of these bodies looked like partners for reestablishing the boundaries of capitalism’s two worlds. Capital, goods, and wages must be free, irrespective of national frontiers. Novel in Haberler’s theory was the rescue of the nation-state as a container for labor. His theory of comparative costs suggested that free trade could compensate for the absence of international labor migration as long as internal barriers established by unions were struck down. Haberler’s vision revealed that the Europe of fortresses was a way of seeing like a commodity. The walls between nations were to fall for goods but not for people.

zh: 正如第2章将要看到的，随着1930年代大萧条的到来，世界的经济宪法遭受了第二次生存性打击。舞台从维也纳转移到日内瓦——自由主义者逃离即将到来的法西斯浪潮——而那种腾挪空间、消除障碍的消极自由主义愿景，将让位于一项主动建构的新自由主义规划，旨在寻找新的超经济条件，以保护世界经济。米塞斯1934年受聘日内瓦教授席位，研讨班的成员们为老师送行，祝愿“他强大的精神为国联指明道路”。
en: As we will see in chapter 2, the economic constitution of the world suffered a second existential blow with the Great Depression of the 1930s. The stage shifted from Vienna to Geneva as liberals fled the coming fascist wave, and the negative liberal vision of clearing space or eliminating obstacles would give way to a productive neoliberal program of finding new extra-economic conditions to protect the world economy. Mises received a Geneva professorship in 1934, and members of his seminar saw their master off with the wish that “his strong spirit will show the League of Nations the way.”
